subject: Residency bridgeplan, VPC keystore handshake & SOC2 artifacts
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@medicus.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medicus.com, Rajiv Patel <r.patel@medicus.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Residency commitment + VPC keystore handoff for procurement pack

Sean —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement/security have one last gate before we sign the PO: we need a short, signed confirmation that production traffic for our tenant will be hosted in the EU (Ireland) and that any operator-facing keystore access for the private deployment will be segregated behind our VPC peering (no cross-tenant operator KMS access).

Concretely they want:
- A one-page residency statement we can attach to the legal packet;
- A technical note describing how Redwood will perform keystore handoff for Privatelink (who has access, key rotation cadence, and whether an HSM-backed KMS is used);
- SOC 2 report summary or SOC 2 Type II readiness note (we can accept a summary plus a signed letter of attestation if the full report is redacted).

Can you route these to me by EOD Wednesday (our legal is moving quickly)? Also cc'ing our security contact Rajiv — they may follow up with a quick questionnaire.

Appreciate it — we want to get the pilot started next month.

— Liam
Liam O'Neill
Director of Procurement, Medicus Health
liam.oneill@medicus.com
+44 7700 900123

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Residency commitment + VPC keystore handoff for procurement pack

Thanks for the clear ask, Liam — we can get this over quickly. High level plan:

- Irene will prepare a one-page residency & hosting commitment (signed) targeted at legal with the EU node and failover details.
- I'll include a short operator-keystore handshake note explaining Privatelink behavior, access controls, and fallback.
- Marissa will attach our SOC 2 summary and provide a single-point attestation letter; if Medicus needs the redacted report we can arrange a secure redaction transfer through our Dataroom.

Irene / Marissa — can you confirm if the keystore runbook and SOC2 PDF are the latest (rotation cadence documented as 90 days, HSM-backed primary KMS)? We should attach the residency matrix and the short runbook.

Liam — we may ask for a mutual action plan after these docs (10–15 minute call) to close the PO. If Wednesday EOD is tight, earliest we can realistically deliver is Wednesday 18:00 UTC; otherwise by Thursday 10:00 UTC. Which do you prefer?

— Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Customer Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@medicus.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Residency commitment + VPC keystore handoff for procurement pack

Hi all — attaching the requested stubs and a short operational note. See attachments list below. Summary highlights (callouts for legal/security):

- Residency: Medicus tenant will be pinned to our eu-west-1 (Ireland) zone for production. Failover to eu-west-2 is backup-only and requires a controlled change request; we document egress paths and logging in the residency matrix.
- Keystore handoff (Privatelink):
  - Primary KMS: customer-managed HSM via BYOK (optional) or Redwood-managed HSM (FIPS 140-2 level 3) if customer opts in.
  - Operator access: Redwood operators do not have plaintext access to customer keys. KMS roles are limited; KMS key policies restrict decrypt/grant operations to the customer key admin principals unless a signed emergency escalation is executed with customer consent.
  - Key rotation: default 90-day rotation, can be shortened per contract. Rotation and key-usage telemetry are logged to tenant-specific Audit Log (retained per agreement).
- SOC 2: attached is our SOC 2 Summary (redacted) and an attestation letter. We can provide a secure, redacted copy of the full report via the dataroom link in 24 hours.

Attachments (stubs):
- redwood_residency_bridgeplan_v1.xlsx (residency matrix + failover rules)
- privatelink-keystore-runbook.pdf (operator access model, escalation playbook)
- soc2-summary-2026.pdf (one-page summary + attestation letter)

If Medicus legal wants a signed page, Sean — can you sign the residency declaration? I can produce an operational appendix for the Legal team to include in the contract schedule.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

From: Rajiv Patel <r.patel@medicus.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@medicus.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 14:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Residency commitment + VPC keystore handoff for procurement pack

Appreciate the fast turnaround — attaching to our procurement packet now. Couple quick clarifying Qs before we close:

1) For the customer-managed HSM option, can you confirm the import/rotation workflow (we run our own key custodians; need to know whether SSH-based import is required or if SOPS-compatible KMIP is supported).
2) Is the Audit Log retention default 12 months or configurable to 24 months for higher-regulated customers?

We can jump on a quick 20-minute call tomorrow at 09:30 BST if that's easiest. If possible, please include the signed one-page residency note for legal during that call — otherwise a scanned PDF is fine.

— Rajiv
Rajiv Patel
Security Architect, Medicus Health
r.patel@medicus.com
